verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community benchmark. It shows Ollama running quantized model variants (q4_K_M, int4, nvfp4) via 'ollama run', which confirms 4-bit integer quantized models are usable. Nothing documents the full range from very low-bit to 8-bit, and no first-party docs describe quantization options or memory savings. missing for 10: first-party documentation of quantization formats, evidence of very low-bit (2-3 bit) and 8-bit options, user-controlled quantization (e.g. quantizing on create), measured memory-footprint reduction.
